title: Random-side Monte Carlo: same trades, same entry and exit bars, side picked by a coin flip
method: For each X0 trade window the raw move r (points, before slippage) is recovered from X0's P&L: r = side0 x ((pnl + 2 x $2) / point value + 2 ticks). A side s in {+1,-1} then earns (s x r - 2 ticks) x point value - 2 x $2, exactly the lab costs. Unit checks: s = side0 reproduces X0 and s = -side0 reproduces the separately run C-REV trade by trade to the cent. Same formula and seeds as make_results.py (TradingView) and local_backtest.py null_test (local).
